definition: to be almost the same as something else
description: On a rooftop terrace in the evening, two young women who look almost exactly the same stand side by side, laughing and pointing at each other: both have long dark wavy hair, gold hoop earrings, dark green satin slip dresses and gold sandals. They lean together laughing, then turn to each other and hug. String lights hang overhead. Around them are a wicker daybed with patterned cushions, a carved wooden door, a green balustrade and patterned tiles, with city towers under a deep blue sky.

en.question: What are the two women doing?

es.answer: Se están señalando la una a la otra.
phrases: señalarse la una a la otra
es.question: ¿Qué están haciendo las dos mujeres?

fr.answer: Elles se montrent du doigt l'une l'autre.
